description: Sonoma County civic data from official county government websites

config.description: Sonoma County civic data from official county government websites

dataSources.contentGoal: Extract scheduled and past Sonoma County Board of Supervisors meetings — meeting date, time, location, agenda PDF link, and minutes link when available. Each item should yield one Meeting record with externalId (date + body slug), title, body ('Sonoma County Board of Supervisors'), scheduledAt (combined date + time), location, agendaUrl, minutesUrl.
hints: Sonoma County Board of Supervisors publishes meeting agendas at this URL
Use these EXACT field names: externalId, title, body, scheduledAt, location, agendaUrl, minutesUrl
Past meetings and upcoming meetings may live on the same page or on tabbed/paginated sections — capture both when present

dataSources.contentGoal: Extract all 5 Sonoma County Board of Supervisors members. For each: name (from img alt or h3 a text), district (digit only from 'Supervisor, District X' text), photoUrl (absolute URL), website (href of h3 a link). externalId = 'sonoma-district-' + district number. Construct externalId as 'california-sonoma-supervisor-{district}' using the district number.
hints: externalId: construct externalId as 'california-sonoma-supervisor-{district}' using the district number

dataSources.contentGoal: Extract the ballot measures filed for each Sonoma County election. The seed URL is a hub; linkDiscovery navigates to each election's 'List of Local Measures That Have Been Filed' page, which is the extraction target. Each measure yields externalId, title, electionDate, summary, and status.

steps.textPattern: Local Measures That Have Been Filed

hints: This IS the measures list page — each list entry is one filed ballot measure (e.g. 'Measure E: Waugh School District Bond … Filed 6/26/26')
Use these EXACT field names: externalId, title, electionDate, summary, status
externalId: construct as 'california-sonoma-' + election date (YYYY-MM-DD) + '-measure-' + the measure letter lowercased, e.g. 'california-sonoma-2026-11-03-measure-e'
title: the measure letter plus its subject, e.g. 'Measure E: Waugh School District Bond'
electionDate: the election this page belongs to, from the page heading or URL (e.g. 'november-3-2026-general-election' → 2026-11-03) — the same date for every measure on the page
summary: the measure's subject plus its sponsoring jurisdiction and measure type when shown (e.g. 'Waugh School District bond measure')
status MUST be exactly one of: pending, passed, failed, withdrawn — a filed measure with no result is 'pending'; any other value is rejected by schema validation and drops the row
Do NOT extract navigation links, argument-submission deadlines, or contact info as measures

dataSources.contentGoal: Extract campaign finance disclosure filings for Sonoma County — committee name, filer type (candidate/measure committee), election, total contributions received, total expenditures made, and top contributors with amounts.
hints: Sonoma County campaign finance disclosure portal
Extract campaign finance filings — committee name, candidate or measure supported/opposed, filing date, total contributions, total expenditures, top contributors (name, amount), and reporting period
Use these EXACT field names: committeeId, committeeName, candidateOrMeasure, filingDate, totalContributions, totalExpenditures, reportingPeriod
